questions.stem: Calculate the number of usable hosts in a /26 subnet. Provide your answer as a whole number.
questions.explanation: A /26 subnet has 6 bits for host addresses (32-26=6). The total number of addresses is $2^6 = 64$. Subtracting the network and broadcast addresses gives 62 usable addresses.

questions.stem: Explain how Network Address Translation (NAT) conserves IPv4 addresses and discuss one potential drawback of NAT.
